sentences.text: Social worker Rachel Burns attended the home of Keith Dawson with District Nurse Siobhan Kelly.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly reported she was worried about how things were at home.
Keith Dawson lives in a house rented from a housing association.
Keith Dawson reported he rang the housing association once and nobody came.
Keith Dawson reported his GP is Dr Morgan at Holloway surgery and he has not been for ages.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly confirmed she has been seeing Keith Dawson for leg ulcers on both legs, twice a week.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly reported that the leg ulcers are slow to heal.
Keith Dawson reported there has been no heating since October.
Keith Dawson reported there is no hot water.
Keith Dawson stated he does not use his fan heater because it costs a fortune.
Keith Dawson reported he has not washed in three to four weeks.
Keith Dawson reported there are rats in the kitchen and he has seen two.
Keith Dawson reported the rats have been at the bread for a few weeks.
Keith Dawson reported he keeps food in tins now because of the rats.
Keith Dawson reported he eats soup and beans, mostly out of the tin.
Keith Dawson stated carers were supposed to do him a meal.
Keith Dawson has a home care package called Bright Days, providing morning and teatime visits.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly reported that in the last two weeks, there should have been 28 visits and 16 were missed, with nothing written for 16 visits.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly reported that four days last week no one came, and Keith Dawson told her he had no meal on those days.
Keith Dawson stated he did not ring the carers because he did not want the bother.
Keith Dawson stated he just wants the heating fixed and the rats gone.
Keith Dawson stated he does not want a home or anything.
Neighbour at number twenty-five told District Nurse Siobhan Kelly that Keith Dawson has been drinking heavily.
District Nurse Siobhan Kelly stated she has not seen any sign of Keith Dawson drinking heavily herself; it is second-hand information from the neighbour.
Keith Dawson described the neighbour at number twenty-five as a 'nosy cow' and stated he is not getting into it.
Keith Dawson reported his brother Phil is in Northby and they talk at Christmas.
Keith Dawson reported his wife left in 2015.
Keith Dawson reported he lives on ESA and is waiting for his pension next year.
Keith Dawson reported the gas is on a meter.
Keith Dawson agreed to the social worker raising a safeguarding concern about the care visits and the state of the house.
